description: Picks the one thing to fix next across your watched domains (or one domain you name), most urgent first: what is wrong, why it matters, the record to paste and the fix guide link, then the next few after it. Read-only: nothing is changed, and the domain owner makes the change at their DNS host. Needs a connected DNSFix™ account with domain watching.
name: what_to_fix_next
title: What should I fix next
